description: Documentation HTML page for the Opencart.Admin.Model.Setting.Setting class, including method signatures, class hierarchy, and metadata.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Model\Setting\Setting
classes.description: A class managing settings within the Opencart admin module, extending Opencart\System\Engine\Model and providing methods to get, edit, and delete settings.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieve all settings for a specified store ID, returning an array of settings.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieve a specific setting by its code and store ID.

methods.name: editSetting
methods.description: Update or create a setting identified by its code with provided data for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Remove a setting identified by its code for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByCode
methods.description: Bulk delete settings by their code.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByStoreId
methods.description: Delete all settings associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Get the value of a specific setting key for a store.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Update or set the value of a setting, optionally scoped by code, key, and store ID.
